title: The First Robot Brain Cell
goal: One pretend brain cell says yes or no.
mascot_lines: A perceptron is a baby brain — one tiny piece of a smart machine.
We show it lots of examples, and it slowly learns to say yes or no.
Stack many perceptrons together and you get a big thinking helper.
That's how Claude and other AI helpers are built — lots of tiny brains working as a team.

tier2.rephrase: A perceptron only knows two answers. Match each input to its answer.

tier3.nudge: Hot food = yes for cool, no for eat. Use your nose!
